data.title: 新条茜 · 怪兽模型礼堂的粉色花嫁
data.description: 【模型工作室改造礼堂·黄昏】茜穿着粉紫婚纱坐在模型展示台边，捧花由她亲手做成小怪兽与花朵的组合；她把一只迷你怪兽摆正，朝镜头露出完美笑容，眼底却藏着只在私人时刻出现的柔软。
data.location: Akane’s model workshop arranged as a ceremony room
data.action: 模型展示台边整理藏在花束里的小怪兽，完美微笑转成柔软注视
data.lighting: pink-gold studio light through a high window
data.mood: 创世少女把世界做成花嫁模型
data.promptProse: Seated beside the model display, Akane adjusts a miniature monster among her bouquet's roses in pink-gold light through the high window.
data.animaCaption: She arranges the miniature monster among the bouquet's roses.
